messages:
mike_eng: Quick sync — final prep for the cut on Friday. I want a quick attendance + coverage poll and to land a minimal agenda. Can folks reply with: yes/alt time, post-cut smoke owner, and any hot blockers?

sara_pm: yes for me, can join full window. I can cover stakeholder rollcall and release notes.

jen_release: I'm in. timeline looks good. Can we add a brief rollback plan item?

alex_oncall: yes. I'll be on standby for 30m after cut for infra checks. prefer to be pinged in #eng-oncall.

grace_qa: yes, I can own smoke tests post-cut. Will need the smoke checklist updated (added two regression asserts).

mike_eng: Awesome. jen — can you drop a 1-paragraph rollback plan here? also adding an agenda template below.

jen_release: Sure — rollback plan (short): If key latency or error rate >3x baseline within 10m post-cut OR failing smoke tests that block login/search, revert to previous model variant + route traffic back to canary pool. Notify SRE + PMs, open incident channel.

mike_eng: Agenda template (copy into calendar invite):
```
- 00:00 — Quick rollcall (owners: PM, release)
- 00:05 — Cut confirmation + who hits the button (release owner)
- 00:10 — Post-cut smoke test pass/fail (QA)
- 00:20 — Telemetry check (SRE/infra)
- 00:30 — Decision window / rollback if needed
- 00:45 — Triage follow-ups / owners assigned
```

mike_eng: Also need a volunteer for the rollback execute step (person who runs the revert). Anyone?

ops-bot: :bell: Reminder: automated canary will run at the cut time. If canary fails, automated rollback is enabled (2-of-3 signals).

alex_oncall: I can be rollback exec if required. comfortable running the revert scripts.

tom_infra: +1 for alex. I'll be on standby to assist with any network or routing issues.

grace_qa: Posted the updated smoke checklist here: https://confluence.company/release-smoke-checks — added login flow asserts and long-prompt regression spot checks.

sara_pm: For attendance — can we confirm stakeholder window? @product_lead @security_team — please confirm or drop delegates.

mike_eng: Noted. If stakeholders can't attend, we'll do a post-cut async summary and required rollback triggers remain the same.

jen_release: One more ask — please ensure all PRs with label "release-blocker" are merged by EOD Thursday. I'll run a final gating script at 17:00.

mike_eng: Copy. Everyone: reply with final yes/no by EOD today. I'll update calendar invite with agenda and owners.

grace_qa: yes — will be ready.

tom_infra: yes.

sara_pm: yes.

jen_release: yes.

alex_oncall: yes.

mike_eng: Great — closing self-check. If anything changes ping me directly. :thumbsup:
